D101_THE_RANKING_HOLDS_BUT_ONLY_TWO_OF_F.the_denominator_rule_now_stated_and_enfo: Two dR2 are comparable iff: D1 same response and units; D2 same scored row set (not merely the same n); D3 SST computed on that full scored set about its own unweighted mean; D4 same weighting in fit, SSE AND SST; D5 same base. FAILING D2 ALONE IS REPAIRABLE by re-expressing both as SSE_reduction / SST_common. FAILING D1 IS NOT REPAIRABLE AND NO CONVENTION RESCUES IT. Enforced structurally: every dR2 in refladder takes its denominator as an EXPLICIT ARGUMENT, so no code path can compute a subset's own SST by accident.

D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.made_by: Coordinator #06 - the most consequential measurement of the session; TRIGGERS and RESOLVES the revisit condition written into D100
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.authority: Measuring the programme's own statistical power is coordinator-scoped. The consequences for how screens are designed are recorded as rulings; nothing user-reserved is touched.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.question: This programme has run ~1,000 candidate cells and killed almost all of them. What is the smallest effect it can detect? Nobody had ever asked.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_NUMBER: Decision stratum (n=5,673), correct-level null, drift-corrected minimum detectable effect at 80% power: ONE PREREGISTERED CELL 0.00102; 18 CELLS 0.00190; 44 CELLS 0.00209; 132-348 CELLS 0.00235. Against the benchmarks - best-ever lead 0.0023, D079's killing ceiling 0.001127, D084's 0.000129.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_SENTENCE_THAT_MATTERS: THE PROGRAMME'S BEST-EVER RESULT SITS EXACTLY ON THE FLOOR OF THE DESIGN CLASS THAT PRODUCED IT. Inside a 132-cell screen the floor of 0.00235 is ABOVE the 0.0023 lead - D089 WOULD HAVE BEEN MISSED. It survived only because it was also measured pooled, where the floor is 0.00112. And D084's 0.000129 ceiling is ROUGHLY EIGHT TIMES BELOW THE BEST FLOOR MEASURED ANYWHERE IN THIS STUDY (0.000285) - that kill was correct in substance, because the ceiling argument is analytic, BUT IT WAS NEVER A MEASUREMENT.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_RETROSPECTIVE_AUDIT: 1,349 recorded cells across seven screens carry a published null width. 56.3% COULD NOT HAVE DETECTED 0.0023. 90.0% could not have detected 0.001127. 98.7% could not have detected 0.000129. AND 628 CELLS WERE BOTH BLIND AND REPORTED AS FAMILY-WISE NULLS. Named, worst first: E0_I0019 availability (D090) 232 uninformative, 315 of 318 cells blind, median floor 0.0059; E0_I0014 residual heterogeneity (D076) 181 of 348; E0_I0024 rebounds and assists (D097) 99 of 250; E0_I0016 efficiency predictors (D085) 53 of 132; E1_I0018 teammate volume (D089) 36 of 154; E1_I0023 usage-defence (D098/D099) 24 of 30; E0_I0017 shot quality (D087) only 3 of 116. D090'S 'ADDS NOTHING TO ABSTENTION' RESTS ON TESTS BLIND TO EFFECTS TEN TIMES THE PROGRAMME'S BEST. D085's '0 of 330 rate cells' and D097's 'less room than points' both inherit substantial blindness. AND THE SCREENS WITH NO MACHINE-READABLE NULL WIDTH CANNOT BE CHECKED AT ALL - their power is UNKNOWN, not adequate.

three_findings_that_correct_the_coordina.1_MULTIPLICITY_SATURATES_AND_THE_LEDGER_: The family-wise penalty is 1.9x going from 1 cell to 18, and only a further 1.24x from 18 to 318. SO COMPARING AN 18-CELL AND A 318-CELL p-VALUE IS ROUGHLY FAIR - the coordinator had assumed the 318-cell bar was punishing relative to 18 and it is not. THE UNFAIR COMPARISON IS EITHER AGAINST A SINGLE PREREGISTERED TEST.
three_findings_that_correct_the_coordina.2_CLUSTER_COUNT_IS_NOT_THE_CONSTRAINT: Team-season (48 clusters) and player-season (600) give the SAME floor (0.00050 vs 0.00056 pooled), while within-date opponent swap (1,632) gives 0.00031 and within-player cyclic (600) gives 0.00148 - a 4.8x spread that cluster count does not order. WHAT SETS THE FLOOR IS HOW MUCH STRUCTURE THE NULL MUST LEAVE STANDING, which is a property of the question rather than of the data.
three_findings_that_correct_the_coordina.3_REFERENCE_QUALITY_IS_A_NARROWER_POWER_: Worth -9% to +16% under entity-swap nulls - i.e. NOTHING - but 3.3x under the within-player cyclic shift. It is a power lever exactly when the null preserves the entity's level. THE COORDINATOR HAS REPEATEDLY DESCRIBED REFERENCE QUALITY AS THE BIGGEST LEVER; it is the biggest BIAS lever and a conditional POWER lever, and those are different claims.

D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THE_HONEST_SENTENCE_FROM_THE_AGENT: Effects smaller than about 0.0003 are NOT DETECTABLE at the correct grouping level from 2021-2024 WNBA data, under any family size, with any reference, using any of this programme's nulls. Reaching 0.000129 at a realistic screen size needs roughly 28x the current sample - order 100 WNBA seasons. THERE IS NO CLEVERER DESIGN.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.WHAT_WOULD_WORK_TODAY_WITH_NO_NEW_DATA: Pooled sample, complete reference, AT MOST 18 PREREGISTERED CELLS, entity swap at the level matching the feature - floor 0.0009 to 0.0010, which detects 0.001-0.002 reliably. The decision stratum reaches 0.002 only if the screen is held to ~18 cells. THE IMMEDIATE FREE GAIN IS TO STOP BROAD SCREENING AND PREREGISTER ONE OR TWO CELLS, WORTH 1.9-2.3x.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.THIS_TRIGGERS_AND_RESOLVES_D100_S_REVISI: D100 recorded, four hours before this returned: 'IF IT RETURNS A FLOOR ABOVE THE EFFECT SIZES BEING HUNTED, THE CAREFUL APPROACH IS FINDING NOTHING ANYWAY and the user's argument becomes the stronger one. This ruling should then be reopened.' THE CONDITION IS MET - the 132-cell floor of 0.00235 exceeds the best-ever lead of 0.0023, and 90% of recorded cells could not detect 0.001127. THE COORDINATOR HAS REOPENED IT AND THE ANSWER IS THAT THE REMEDY IS NOT WHAT THE USER PROPOSED. Looser provenance adds bias and buys NO power - the floor is set by sample size, family size and how much structure the null must preserve, none of which contamination improves. THE MEASURED REMEDY IS NARROWER SCREENS, POOLED SAMPLES AND PREREGISTERED CELLS, which is free and available today. D100 STANDS, and it now stands on a measurement rather than on an argument.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.discipline_including_a_preregistered_che: Prereg hashed before any statistic (9260f7db...), with ONE addition after hashing - a null rather than a candidate, whose result went AGAINST the hypothesis that motivated it - and zero drops. THE PRE-COMMITTED FALSIFICATION CHECK FAILED: null width drifted -73% to +269% (up to +506% on one cell) when effects were planted, past the 10% threshold. AS PREREGISTERED, EVERY HEADLINE WAS RECOMPUTED with the null measured on the planted response, and the uncorrected numbers were KEPT ON DISK rather than deleted. Reporting them would have overstated the cyclic floor 3x and understated the within-date floor 2x. Machinery validated: fast dR2 against the kit at 7.6e-17, closed form against a literal refit at 1.5e-16, and type-I error at zero effect of 0.040-0.069 across all 24 cells with median 0.049.
D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.an_incidental_finding_the_agent_refused_: While using opponent defensive rating as a POWER CARRIER it observed an in-sample screening dR2 of 0.0082-0.0086 against points-per-minute on the decision stratum, p 0.0017 on both opponent-level nulls. IT DELIBERATELY DID NOT RAISE THIS AS A LEAD - single uncorrected in-sample cell, on an outcome D085 did not screen the opponent family against - and recorded it in its notes so it is not lost. That is the correct handling of a promising accident, and it is a THIRD independent sighting of the opponent-defence signal after D098 and D099.

ruling.1_SCREEN_DESIGN_CHANGES_IMMEDIATELY: Broad sweeps are the wrong instrument at this sample size. Future screens should be POOLED where the question permits, carry AT MOST ~18 PREREGISTERED CELLS, and use the null that matches the feature's variation. This is worth 1.9-2.3x for free.
ruling.2_EVERY_SCREEN_MUST_PUBLISH_null_mean_AN: One line, and it is the difference between a null that can be audited and one that cannot. Seven screens could be checked here; the rest could not.
ruling.3_THE_NAMED_NULLS_ARE_DOWNGRADED_TO_UNIN: A blind test is not evidence of absence. D090's abstention conclusion, D085's 0-of-330 and D097's headroom comparison must all now be quoted with their power. NONE of them is thereby shown wrong - the point is that they were never tests.
ruling.4_D084_S_KILL_STANDS_ON_ITS_ARITHMETIC_N: The ceiling argument is analytic and survives. The empirical null attached to it was uninformative and should not be cited.

D103_THE_DETECTION_FLOOR_MORE_THAN_HALF_.preserved_disagreement: The coordinator notes this result is the strongest possible argument for its OWN past caution and should be read with that in mind - a power analysis that says 'your negative results were uninformative' also says 'your slow careful process was not the problem'. The genuine sting is elsewhere: the programme spent months running broad sweeps at a sample size where broad sweeps cannot work, and NOBODY COMPUTED THE FLOOR BEFORE RUNNING THEM. That is a planning failure rather than an execution failure, and no amount of rigour inside a screen could have compensated for it.

D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.authority: E1 screening is coordinator-scoped and non-claiming. No champion fitting occurred.
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.question: The user argued: team points are the sum of player points, so a measurable team-level home advantage MUST appear at player level - an accounting identity, not a hypothesis. Where does it go?
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.answer: IT IS FREE THROWS - 97.6% of the gap - AND IT IS ENTIRELY WITHIN-PLAYER. The accounting balances to a residual of -4.2e-16. AND IT IS TOO SMALL TO MATTER FOR A FORECAST, which was measurable in advance.
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.THE_TEAM_EFFECT: Regular season 2021-2024, 888 games: home teams score +0.965 points per game (82.367 against 81.402), p 0.036 under an exact per-game sign-flip null. THE PLAYOFF STRATUM IS EXCLUDED AND LABELLED - playoff home court is AWARDED TO THE BETTER SEED, so its +5.683 contrast is team strength wearing a venue costume. That exclusion is the difference between a finding and an artefact and the agent made it unprompted.

BOTH_OF_THE_COORDINATOR_S_CANDIDATE_HIDI.minutes: TEAM MINUTES ARE IDENTICAL FOR BOTH TEAMS IN 970 OF 970 GAMES (200, plus 25 per SHARED overtime). The gap is exactly zero. The coordinator had flagged rotation redistribution as a candidate leak; it cannot be one at team level.
BOTH_OF_THE_COORDINATOR_S_CANDIDATE_HIDI.PACE_WAS_THE_COORDINATOR_S_LEADING_HYPOT: POSSESSIONS ARE A SHARED GAME PROPERTY. The gap is +0.135 at p 0.165, and corr(home possessions, away possessions) is 0.816. The coordinator wrote that if home advantage were mostly extra possessions then 'every per-minute and per-rate screen this programme ran would show nothing while totals differ' - THE PER-RATE SCREENS WERE NOT BLIND TO A PACE EFFECT; THERE IS NO PACE EFFECT. Two teams in one game share a possession count by construction, which the coordinator should have known before proposing it.

D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.IT_IS_FREE_THROWS_AND_THE_IDENTITY_IS_EX: Decomposing through the exact identity points = 2*FG2M + 3*FG3M + FTM with residual 0.000: FREE THROWS CONTRIBUTE +0.941, WHICH IS 97.6% OF THE ENTIRE GAP; three-pointers +0.199; and TWO-POINTERS ARE NEGATIVE at -0.176. Splitting again: FT ATTEMPTS +1.087 with accuracy contributing only +0.4 percentage points. Fouls committed -0.592 and fouls drawn +0.592. UNDER FAMILY-WISE CORRECTION ACROSS 25 PRESELECTED TEAM CELLS, ONLY FTA (p 0.00005) AND THE FOUL DIFFERENTIAL (0.00015) SURVIVE - points itself sits at 0.029 and points-per-possession at 0.069. THE WHISTLE IS A CLEANER SIGNAL THAN THE POINTS IT CAUSES. Home advantage in this league is, to a first approximation, a refereeing effect.
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.THE_RECONCILIATION_BALANCES_EXACTLY: Team effect +0.965090. Player-side reconstruction of both home and away means: error 0.00e+00. WITHIN-PLAYER term (the same players producing more) +1.314419 = 136.2%. COMPOSITION term (who plays) -0.349329 = -36.2%. RESIDUAL -4.2e-16. Each term was tested against its own null by recomputing the whole 265-player decomposition on 4,000 sign-flip draws that preserve the home/away game counts: WITHIN-PLAYER p 0.028, COMPOSITION p 0.545 - NOISE. So ALL of it is the same players scoring more and NONE is rotation or roster. The within-player term splits into minutes +0.241 (18%) and points-per-minute +1.073 (82%). The same identity on free-throw makes gives within-player 104.9% and composition -4.9%.
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.THE_MAIN_EFFECT_TEST_IS_NULL_AND_INTERPR: COMPUTED BEFORE FITTING ANYTHING: a player's points standard deviation is 7.457, so the per-game increment against a venue-blended reference is +0.051 points - 0.68% OF ONE STANDARD DEVIATION - and THE LARGEST dR2 A PERFECT HOME TERM COULD ADD IS 4.63e-05. OBSERVED: +6.5e-05 pooled (p 0.556), best cell +1.07e-04 (p 0.168), MAE +0.028%. THE MEASUREMENT LANDED ON ITS OWN A-PRIORI CEILING. That is the cleanest possible resolution of the user's question: the effect is REAL, it is EXACTLY WHERE THE ARITHMETIC SAYS IT SHOULD BE, and it is TOO SMALL TO MOVE A FORECAST. A fake venue label through the identical pipeline returns -2.3e-05.
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.THE_COORDINATOR_S_SECOND_HYPOTHESIS_IS_A: REFERENCE ABSORPTION does not explain the earlier nulls. A venue-split reference is WORSE IN 8 OF 8 CELLS by 3.3-5.6% MAE at p 0.0002 every time. Absorption is real as arithmetic - it halves the detectable increment - but UN-BLENDING COSTS ROUGHLY 100 TIMES MORE THAN THE SIGNAL IT RECOVERS. The coordinator proposed absorption as a likely hiding place; it is a real mechanism and a net loss to exploit.
D104_HOME_ADVANTAGE_IS_FREE_THROWS_THE_A.EASTBOUND_TRAVEL_IS_REFUTED_AGAINST_ITS_: The direction was hashed before any statistic.
